stage_scene_gate.action: A key snaps while Zuv locks an already-ajar door; Aachu joins him and they attempt different fixes before an equal-footed argument.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu notices the nick on Zuv’s right thumb and directly dabs it with one loose tissue; he holds that hand steady without their irritation disappearing.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention moves from the damaged lock and incompatible tools to the thumb nick and tissue, then returns to the repeated departure ritual.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The broken key moves from lock to ledge to catchall; Aachu’s right hand moves one loose tissue into direct contact with the nick on Zuv’s presented right thumb.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Their eye-lines reconnect at the threshold before the care gesture closes the body distance.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: They still leave in separate directions that evening, but the tissue retained on his thumb proves care remains active inside the friction.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The next-morning wallet-and-bottle relay repeats beside a repaired lock, turning ordinary habit into proof that they already operate as an us.
